description: First 50 seeds only - testing 'starting well' quality

phrases.english: but I enjoy trying
phrases.other: ond dw i'n joio trio
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'joio' is excellent South Welsh colloquial (from English 'enjoy'). 'trio' natural shortening. Good South markers.

phrases.english: but where do you want to go now?
phrases.other: ond ble wyt ti'n moyn mynd nawr?
phrases.notes: Natural English question. 'moyn' is key South Welsh marker (vs North 'eisiau'). 'ble' standard. 'wyt ti'n' slightly formal for South (could be 'ti'n'), but acceptable.

phrases.english: but I want to practice speaking
phrases.other: ond dw i'n moyn ymarfer siarad
phrases.notes: Natural English. Good South Welsh with 'moyn'. 'ymarfer siarad' correct verbal noun construction.

phrases.english: I want to learn how to improve
phrases.other: dw i'n moyn dysgu sut i wella
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'sut i wella' - correct soft mutation after 'i'. 'moyn' good South marker.

phrases.english: but I can't remember what I want to say
phrases.other: ond alla i ddim cofio beth dw i'n moyn dweud
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'alla i ddim' correct South form with soft mutation. 'moyn' good. Complex sentence well-constructed.

phrases.english: I want to try to say something in Welsh
phrases.other: dw i'n moyn trio dweud rhywbeth yn Gymraeg
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'yn Gymraeg' correct soft mutation after 'yn'. 'trio' good colloquial form. 'moyn' South marker.

phrases.english: I still need to learn
phrases.other: dw i dal angen dysgu
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'dal' good South colloquial for 'still' (vs formal 'o hyd'). 'angen' works but 'dal angen' is slightly formal - could also use 'dal isie' in very casual South speech.

phrases.english: I don't want to stop talking because I think it's interesting
phrases.other: dw i ddim yn moyn stopo siarad achos dw i'n meddwl bod hi'n ddiddorol
phrases.notes: English natural. 'stopo' is good colloquial. 'bod hi'n ddiddorol' - soft mutation correct. Issue: 'hi' refers to feminine noun but 'it' is abstract here; 'bod e'n' might be more natural for an abstract subject, or just 'bo' fe'n'. Minor issue.

phrases.english: I can't remember how to try
phrases.other: alla i ddim cofio sut i drio
phrases.notes: Natural English (slightly unusual semantically but valid). 'sut i drio' - correct soft mutation after 'i'. 'alla i ddim' correct South form.

phrases.english: I'm going to practice more because I want to improve
phrases.other: dw i'n mynd i ymarfer mwy achos dw i'n moyn gwella
phrases.notes: Natural English. Good South Welsh. 'mynd i ymarfer' - no mutation needed after 'i' before vowel. 'moyn gwella' excellent.

phrases.english: I must stop for about a month
phrases.other: mae rhaid i fi stopo am biti mis
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'am biti mis' - excellent South Welsh colloquial for 'about a month' (from 'piti' = pitiful small amount). 'stopo' good informal. 'rhaid i fi' correct.

phrases.english: you're doing what you need to do to speak Welsh very well
phrases.other: ti'n gwneud beth ti angen gwneud i siarad Cymraeg yn dda iawn
phrases.notes: English slightly wordy but natural. Welsh good overall. 'Cymraeg' should arguably have soft mutation 'Gymraeg' after 'siarad' in some contexts, but this is borderline. 'ti angen' natural colloquial.

phrases.english: I think you're doing something interesting
phrases.other: dw i'n meddwl bo' ti'n gwneud rhywbeth diddorol
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'bo' ti'n' excellent South Welsh contraction of 'bod ti'n'. Natural and colloquial.

phrases.english: but I enjoy speaking Welsh
phrases.other: ond dw i'n joio siarad Cymraeg
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'joio' excellent South Welsh colloquial. Clean sentence.

phrases.english: you've learnt to speak Welsh a little more slowly
phrases.other: ti 'di dysgu siarad Cymraeg bach yn arafach
phrases.notes: English slightly awkward - 'you've learned to speak a bit more slowly' sounds more natural than 'a little more slowly'. Welsh 'ti 'di' excellent South contraction. 'bach yn arafach' natural.

phrases.english: I don't want to go with you
phrases.other: dw i ddim yn moyn mynd gyda ti
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'gyda ti' is South Welsh (vs North 'efo ti'). 'moyn' good South marker. Clean construction.

phrases.english: but I must go now
phrases.other: ond mae'n rhaid i fi fynd nawr
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'fynd' correct soft mutation after 'i'. 'mae'n rhaid' correct construction.

phrases.english: how to say something
phrases.other: sut i ddweud rhywbeth
phrases.notes: Natural English fragment. 'ddweud' correct soft mutation after 'i'. Clean.

phrases.english: but I'd better go now
phrases.other: ond well i fi fynd nawr
phrases.notes: Natural English idiom. 'well i fi fynd' - excellent Welsh idiom for 'I'd better'. 'fynd' correct soft mutation.

phrases.english: I still need to improve
phrases.other: dw i dal angen gwella
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'dal angen' acceptable. 'gwella' correct. Solid but slightly textbook feel.

phrases.english: I still want to learn Welsh
phrases.other: dw i dal yn moyn dysgu Cymraeg
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'dal yn moyn' - the 'yn' here is slightly unusual; 'dw i dal moyn' would be more colloquial South. Minor point.

phrases.english: I was trying to say that I've been learning for about a month now
phrases.other: o'n i'n trio dweud bo' fi wedi bod yn dysgu am biti mis nawr
phrases.notes: Natural English. Excellent South Welsh: 'o'n i'n' (past progressive), 'bo' fi' (contracted 'bod fi'), 'am biti mis' (about a month). Complex sentence well-handled.

phrases.english: I'm going to try to say something in Welsh again
phrases.other: dw i'n mynd i drio dweud rhywbeth yn Gymraeg eto
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'yn Gymraeg' correct soft mutation. 'drio' correct soft mutation after 'i'. Well-formed.

phrases.english: I want to practice more
phrases.other: dw i'n moyn ymarfer mwy
phrases.notes: Natural English. Clean South Welsh with 'moyn'. Simple and correct.

phrases.english: but I can't remember what to say
phrases.other: ond alla i ddim cofio beth i ddweud
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'alla i ddim' correct South form. 'beth i ddweud' correct soft mutation. Clean.

phrases.english: to remember how to say something
phrases.other: cofio sut i ddweud rhywbeth
phrases.notes: Natural English infinitive phrase. 'sut i ddweud' correct soft mutation. Clean construction.

phrases.english: I'd like to try something else now
phrases.other: hoffen i drio rhywbeth arall nawr
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'hoffen i' correct conditional. 'drio' correct soft mutation after 'hoffen i'. Natural flow.

phrases.english: I'd like to say something else if I can
phrases.other: hoffen i ddweud rhywbeth arall os galla i
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'hoffen i ddweud' correct soft mutation. 'os galla i' good South form. Clean construction.

phrases.english: I'm trying to practice speaking
phrases.other: dw i'n trio ymarfer siarad
phrases.notes: Natural English. Clean South Welsh. 'ymarfer siarad' natural verbal noun construction.

phrases.english: I still need to say something now
phrases.other: dw i dal angen dweud rhywbeth nawr
phrases.notes: English slightly awkward - 'I still need to say something now' is a bit redundant (still + now). Welsh is correct. 'dal angen' good South.

phrases.english: I must practice speaking Welsh
phrases.other: mae rhaid i fi ymarfer siarad Cymraeg
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'mae rhaid i fi' correct construction. Clean phrase.

phrases.english: you've learnt what you need to do
phrases.other: ti 'di dysgu be' ti angen gwneud
phrases.notes: Natural English. Excellent South Welsh: 'ti 'di' (contracted 'ti wedi'), 'be'' (contracted 'beth'). Very colloquial and natural.

phrases.english: you're doing something
phrases.other: ti'n gwneud rhywbeth
phrases.notes: Simple, natural English. Clean South Welsh with 'ti'n' contraction.

phrases.english: to remember more
phrases.other: cofio mwy
phrases.notes: Simple English infinitive. Clean Welsh. Minimal but correct.

phrases.english: to remember how to speak
phrases.other: cofio sut i siarad
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'sut i siarad' - no mutation needed as 'siarad' doesn't mutate after 'i' (s- doesn't undergo soft mutation). Correct.

phrases.english: but I've just started to learn Welsh
phrases.other: ond dw i newydd ddechrau dysgu Cymraeg
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'newydd ddechrau' - correct soft mutation after 'newydd'. Clean construction.

phrases.english: I've been learning for about a month
phrases.other: dw i 'di bod yn dysgu am biti mis
phrases.notes: Natural English. Excellent South Welsh: 'dw i 'di' (contracted), 'am biti mis' (about a month - excellent South idiom).

phrases.english: do you want to speak a little more slowly?
phrases.other: wyt ti'n moyn siarad bach yn arafach?
phrases.notes: English natural. 'wyt ti'n' is slightly formal for South - 'ti'n moyn' would be more casual. 'bach yn arafach' good. 'moyn' key South marker.

phrases.english: I'm trying to learn Welsh again
phrases.other: dw i'n trio dysgu Cymraeg eto
phrases.notes: Natural English. Clean South Welsh. 'trio' colloquial form.

phrases.english: how to say anything else
phrases.other: sut i ddweud unrhywbeth arall
phrases.notes: Natural English fragment. 'sut i ddweud' correct soft mutation. 'unrhywbeth' correct.

phrases.english: I still need to say
phrases.other: dw i dal angen dweud
phrases.notes: English incomplete/fragment (needs object). Welsh correct. 'dal angen' good South. Functional but fragment feels incomplete.

phrases.english: I've still got more to learn
phrases.other: mae dal gyda fi fwy i ddysgu
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'gyda fi' is South Welsh (vs North 'gen i'). 'fwy i ddysgu' - 'ddysgu' correct soft mutation. 'mae dal' slightly unusual word order - could be 'mae gyda fi fwy i ddysgu o hyd' but this works.

phrases.english: what I wanted to do
phrases.other: beth o'n i'n moyn gwneud
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'o'n i'n moyn' excellent South Welsh past progressive with 'moyn'.

phrases.english: and I enjoy trying to remember what I want to say
phrases.other: a dw i'n joio trio cofio beth dw i'n moyn dweud
phrases.notes: Natural English. Excellent South Welsh with 'joio', 'trio', 'moyn'. Complex sentence well-constructed.

phrases.english: I still need to say something in Welsh
phrases.other: dw i dal angen dweud rhywbeth yn Gymraeg
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'yn Gymraeg' correct soft mutation. 'dal angen' good South.

phrases.english: I've just started to learn Welsh
phrases.other: dw i newydd ddechrau dysgu Cymraeg
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'newydd ddechrau' correct soft mutation after 'newydd'. Clean.

phrases.english: I must remember something else
phrases.other: mae rhaid i fi gofio rhywbeth arall
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'gofio' correct soft mutation of 'cofio' after 'i'. Clean construction.

phrases.english: I want to say that you speak Welsh very well
phrases.other: dw i'n moyn dweud bo' ti'n siarad Cymraeg yn dda iawn
phrases.notes: Natural English. Excellent South Welsh: 'moyn', 'bo' ti'n' (contracted). Well-constructed complex sentence.

phrases.english: I'd better say that I've been learning for about a month now
phrases.other: well i fi ddweud bo' fi wedi bod yn dysgu am biti mis nawr
phrases.notes: Natural English. Excellent South Welsh: 'well i fi' (I'd better), 'ddweud' soft mutation, 'bo' fi' (contracted), 'am biti mis' (about a month). Complex sentence well-handled.

phrases.english: and you speak it very well
phrases.other: a ti'n siarad hi'n dda iawn
phrases.notes: Natural English. 'hi'n' - using feminine pronoun for 'it' (referring to iaith/language, which is feminine). Correct but 'ti'n ei siarad hi'n dda iawn' would be more complete with the object pronoun. Acceptable colloquial shortcut.

summary.assessment: EXCELLENT - Round 3 shows strong quality across all 50 phrases. No phrases below functional level (5). All phrases are in the 'strong' (7-8) range. South Welsh dialect markers are consistently used (moyn, joio, gyda, dal, am biti mis, bo', ti 'di). Mutations are correctly applied throughout. English naturalness is high. This is ready for production use.

worst_3_phrases.english: I still need to say something now
worst_3_phrases.other: dw i dal angen dweud rhywbeth nawr
worst_3_phrases.reason: English slightly redundant ('still' + 'now'). Welsh is correct but the source phrase is awkward.
Incomplete fragment - English needs an object. Feels truncated rather than a natural utterance.

worst_3_phrases.english: I've still got more to learn
worst_3_phrases.other: mae dal gyda fi fwy i ddysgu
worst_3_phrases.reason: 'mae dal' is slightly unusual word order. More natural might be 'mae gyda fi fwy o hyd i ddysgu' or restructured. Works but feels constructed.

summary.mutation_accuracy: 100% - All soft mutations after 'i', 'yn' (before adjectives), 'newydd', and in 'alla i ddim' are correctly applied.
summary.recommendation: Approve for production. Quality is consistently high with excellent South Welsh dialect representation. Consider minor English phrasing review for the 3 noted phrases if time permits, but not blocking.
